acceptance: Every action has explicit capability, confirmation, immutable receipt, and repair path.
verifiedBy: node --test apps/membrane-hub/tests/actions.mjs tests/hub-actions/actions.test.mjs (13/13 pass, executed); node --test apps/membrane-hub/tests/*.mjs (32/32 pass, executed, no regression across the Hub). cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all -- --check, cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace, pnpm --dir apps/membrane-hub test, and cargo check --manifest-path apps/membrane-hub/src-tauri/Cargo.toml are deferred to the Wave 4 phased gate (Gate phase 3.2) per MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md and were not run.
observed: Explicit capability: actionDefinitions (apps/membrane-hub/src/actions.mjs) declares six actions -- restart, reconcile, rotate-token, review-proposal, restore-quarantine, apply-update -- each bound to its own hub.action.* capability string and its own repair/hub/<action> repair path; test 'all post-v1 actions require a distinct capability & repair path' asserts both sets are pairwise distinct (new Set(...).size === actionDefinitions.length). buildHubActionRequest only produces a request when grants(snapshot) contains a matching {capability, receiptId} entry for that exact action; a missing grant renders 'unavailable'/'capability-not-granted' (test 'missing nonce or capability stays unavailable without UI optimism'). Confirmation: buildHubActionRequest rejects any confirmationNonce that is not a 16-128 character [A-Za-z0-9._:-] string with 'unavailable'/'confirmation-nonce-required', proven by the same test; a valid nonce is carried unmodified onto the frozen request (test 'builder never dispatches or claims success'). Immutable receipt: operations/hub/actions/hub-actions.v1.json#runtimeReceipt defines a closed, additionalProperties:false shape (receiptId, actionId, capabilityReceiptId, requestDigest, a closed outcome enum, an ISO occurredAt, runtimeIdentity, and a repair/hub/<action> repairPath); the new applyRuntimeReceipt(request, receipt) is the sole path from a request to a rendered outcome and enforces that schema at runtime plus cryptographic binding to the exact request (matching actionId, capabilityReceiptId, requestDigest -- a sha256 over the canonical actionId/capability/capabilityReceiptId/confirmationNonce/payload -- and repairPath). A shape-invalid receipt renders 'unavailable'/'receipt-shape-invalid'; a shape-valid but unbound (tampered digest, wrong repair path) receipt renders 'unavailable'/'receipt-not-bound-to-request' (test 'a receipt bound to a different request, action, or repair path is rejected as unproven'); a receipt can never be applied to a request whose capability grant was never present (test 'a receipt can never be applied to a request that was never granted', reason 'no-pending-request'). Every accepted receipt is Object.freeze'd before being surfaced (test 'a shape-valid, correctly bound receipt is the only way to reach proven' asserts Object.isFrozen(outcome.receipt)). A bound receipt whose outcome is 'rejected' renders state 'rejected', never 'proven' (test 'a runtime-rejected outcome never becomes a proven success') -- the Hub never upgrades a runtime rejection or a malformed/forged claim into an optimistic success; only a bound, shape-valid receipt with outcome applied/repaired/rolled-back renders 'proven'. Repair path: every outcome branch (awaiting-trusted-runtime, unavailable, rejected, proven) carries the action's repairPath through to the caller and the read-only renderHubActionStatus renderer (test 'repair path survives every outcome: a rejected or unbound receipt still surfaces the exact repair route' in tests/hub-actions/actions.test.mjs, and the renderer test in apps/membrane-hub/tests/actions.mjs). The renderer itself only ever sets root.innerHTML and HTML-escapes every field (test 'renderer is read-only, escapes evidence, & never renders unproven success'), matching the same read-only/escapes-evidence contract already proven for apps/membrane-hub/src/agents-adapters.mjs. The Rust Hub facade (engine/crates/membrane-runtime/src/hub.rs) was left untouched and still hard-codes read_only:true with only hub.capabilities/hub.snapshot in HUB_OPERATIONS, so this task adds no new ability for the Hub to dispatch or claim success on its own -- it only defines and proves the request/receipt contract a future trusted runtime must satisfy. Status is recorded as pending_book_gate, not pass, per the book-mode execution rules: acceptance is finalized only at the Wave 4 phased gate (Gate phase 3.2) after the manifest commands are run there.
